questions.q_en: The area of a circular field is 9856 cm2. If a person crosses the field along the diameter, calculate the distance that he will travel (in cm).
questions.solution_en:
πr2 = 9856

=> (22/7) r2=9856

=> r2=9856*7/22

=> r= 56

So, the distance that he has to travel = 2*56 = 112 cm

questions.q_en: A train covers 450 km at a uniform speed. If the speed had been 5 km/h more, it would have taken 1 hour less to cover the same distance. How much time will it take to cover 315 km at its usual speed?
questions.solution_en:
Let the speed of train = 's' km/h

According to the question:

s2 + 5s = 2250

s2 + 5s - 2250 = 0

After solving:

s = 45

Time taken to cover 315 km at usual speed = 315/s = 315/45 = 7 hours

questions.q_en: A, B, and C run simultaneously, starting from a point, around a circular track of length 900 m, at respective speeds of 13 m/s, 17 m/s, and 21 m/s in the same direction. After how much time will they meet for the first time?
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed of A and C = 21 - 13 = 8 m/s

Relative speed of B and C = 21 - 17 = 4 m/s

Net relative speed = 8 - 4 = 4 m/s

Time taken by them to meet for the first time = 900/4 = 225 sec = 3 minutes 45 seconds

questions.q_en: When y is divided by 29, the remainder obtained is 4. What will be the remainder when y5 is divided by 29?
questions.solution_en:
Let us take an example to understand the concept of remainder:

When x is divided by y it gives the remainder 'a'. If we are performing any operation on x, then the same operation will be performed on 'a'.

Like, the remainder obtained on dividing xn by y is equal to the remainder obtained on diving an by y.

Here, remainder 4 is obtained on dividing y by 29. Then,

New remainder = remainder obtained when y5/29

= remainder obtained when 45/29

= remainder obtained when 1024/29

= 9

questions.q_en: A boy standing on a railway platform, noticed that a train took 42 seconds to completely pass through that platform, which was 110 m long and it took 18 seconds to pass him. Find the speed of the train.
questions.solution_en:
In first condition,

(Length of train + 110) m covered by train in 42 seconds.

In second condition,

Length of train = distance covered by train in 18 seconds

Therefore,

Train covers 110 m in 24 seconds.

Speed of train = (110/24) * (18/5) = 16.5 kmph

questions.q_en: WXYZ is a cyclic quadrilateral. Diagonals WY and ZX intersect each other at M. If ∠ XMY = 126° and ∠ MYZ = 40°, then what is the measure of ∠ YWX?
questions.solution_en:
Given,

∠ XMY = 126°

Therefore, ∠ ZMY = 180 - 126 = 54°

In Δ ZMY,

∠ MZY + ∠ ZMY + ∠ MYZ = 180°

∠ MZY + 54 + 40 = 180

∠ MZY = 180 - 94

∠ MZY = 86°

∠ YWX = ∠ MZY = 86° [angle subtended in same segment]

questions.q_en: Three runners Ritu, Rupesh, and Rishu run a race, with Ritu finishing 60 metres ahead of Rupesh and 90 m ahead of Rishu. In another race of the same length, Rupesh finished 35 meters ahead of Rishu. Each runner travels the entire distance at a constant speed. Find the length of the race.
questions.solution_en:
Let the length of the race be 'D' meters

When Ritu traveled a distance of D meters, then Rupesh traveled (D - 60) meters and Rishu traveled (D - 90) meters

When Rupesh traveled D meters, then Rishu traveled (D - 35) meters

Comparing both scenarios of Rupesh and Rishu

(D - 60)/ (D - 90) = D/(D - 35)

D2 - 35D - 60D + 2100 = D2 - 90D

5D = 2100

D = 420 meters

questions.q_en: The greatest four - digit number that end with 6 is ______ more than the smallest four - digit numbers that begins with 8.
questions.solution_en:
a + 5 is an odd number, for even number, a + 5 is added or subtracted from 1, 3, 5 etc.

(a) a + 4 = a + 5 - 1 (even), a + 3 = a + 5 - 2 (odd)

(b) a = a + 5 - 5 (even), a - 1 = a + 5 - 6 (odd)

(c) a + 1 = a + 5 - 4 (odd), a + 2 = a + 5 - 3 (even)

(d) a + 2 = a + 5 - 3 (even), a + 4 = a + 5 - 1 (even)

Hence, option 'd' is correct.

questions.q_en: Find the perimeter of major sector of a circle of radius 12 meters, whose minor sector subtends an angle of 75° at the center.
questions.solution_en:
Arc length of any sector of a circle which makes angle of θ at the centre = 2πr * (θ/360)

Total perimeter of the sector = Arc length + 2 * Radius = 2πr * (θ/360) + 2r

Since minor sector makes an angle of 75° at the centre which means major sector will make angle equal to 360° - 75° = 285°

So, perimeter of major sector = 2π * 12 * (285/360) + 2 * 12

= 19π + 24 meters

questions.q_en: In an election between two candidates, 80% of the voters cast their votes, out of which 4% votes were declared invalid. A candidate got 15,360 votes which were 80% of the valid votes. Find the total number of votes.
questions.solution_en:
Let the total number of voters be 100x

So number of voters who cast their vote:- 80% of 100x=80x

Number of valid votes:- 96% of 80x= 76.8x

According to question:-

76.8x*80/100=15360

x=153600/(76.8*8)=250

So 100x=25000.

Option (c) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: In a square ABCD, E is a point inside the square such that DDEC is an equilateral triangle. If E is joined to vertices A and B of the square, what is the degree measure of ∠AEB?
questions.solution_en:
Since CDE is an equilateral triangle and ABCD is a square.

So, AB = BC = CD = AD = CE = DE

∠CED = ∠CDE = ∠DCE = 60°

∠ADE = 90° - ∠CDE = 90° - 60° = 30°

In ΔADE:

∠AED = ∠DAE = Let say x (AD = DE)

∠AED + ∠DAE + ∠ADE = 180°

x + x + 30° = 180°

x = 75°

∠AED = ∠BEC = x = 75° [From the similarity]

∠AED + ∠AEB + ∠BEC + ∠CED = 360°

75° + ∠AEB + 75° + 60° = 360°

∠AEB = 150°

questions.q_en: Find the unit digit of the given expression: (9125 - 2250)
questions.solution_en:
We know that when the power of 9 is an odd number than the unit digit will 9.

So, unit digit of 9125 = 9

And, cyclicity of 2 is 4.

E.g. 21 = 2, 22 = 4, 23 = 8, 24 = 16, 25 = 32, here we see that after 4 terms unit digit started repeating again.

After dividing the power of 2 by 4 remainder will be 2.

So, 22 = 4

Hence, unit digit = 9 - 4 = 5

questions.q_en: A bike covers a certain distance at a certain time at the speed of 64 km/hr. If at the speed of 72 km/hr, the bike covers 40 km more at the same time, then find the original distance (in km) covered by the bike.
questions.solution_en:
Let the time be 't' hour.

According to question,

72 * t - 64 * t = 40 km

t = 5

The original distance = 5 * 64 = 320 km

questions.q_en: The radius of a circle with center O, is 9 cm. From an external point P, PA and PB are two tangents at A and B are drawn. Find the value of (PA - OA), if the perimeter of quadrilateral PAOB is 40 cm.
questions.solution_en:
Radius of circle = 9 cm

Therefore, OA = OB = 9 cm

From point P, PA and PB are two tangents at A and B are drawn, therefore PA = PB = Y (Let)

Perimeter of quadrilateral = 40 cm

PA + AO + OB + PB = 40

Y + 9 + 9 + Y = 40

2Y = 22

Y = 11

Therefore, the value of (PA - OA) = 11 - 9 = 2 cm.
